question: Cricket became an international game with the formation of the _______ in 1909.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ICC**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cricket became an international game** with the formation of the **International Cricket Council (ICC)** in 1909.
 
• The ICC is the global governing body for cricket and is responsible for the organization and governance of the game's major international tournaments, including the Cricket World Cup.
